create.name: Penelope Smith
create.bio:
Penelope Smith is an American teacher of animal communication who has worked professionally in the field since the 1970s and named it 'interspecies telepathic communication'. She holds bachelor's and master's degrees in the social sciences and trained in human counselling and holistic bodywork before turning her lifelong ability to understand animals into a profession. Her students call her the grandmother of interspecies communication, and many of today's professional animal communicators began with her courses.

She teaches that everyone is born able to communicate mind to mind with other species, and that this ability can be remembered through presence, receptivity and practice. Her books Animal Talk, When Animals Speak and Animals in Spirit are classics of the field, the last on animals' experience of death and the afterlife. She founded and edited Species Link magazine, formulated a code of ethics for animal communicators in 1990, and started the Animal Communicators Coalition for Animal Welfare. She now teaches through online courses, including on The Shift Network, and through audio courses and recorded seminars, and no longer offers private consultations.

books.title: Animal Talk: Interspecies Telepathic Communication
books.author: Penelope Smith
books.description: Her first and best-known book, a practical introduction to telepathic communication with animals, with exercises for developing the ability and stories from decades of practice.

books.title: When Animals Speak: Techniques for Bonding With Animal Companions
books.author: Penelope Smith
books.description: A follow-on to Animal Talk with more advanced techniques and many accounts of conversations with animals, exploring their awareness and their view of life.

books.title: Animals in Spirit: Our Faithful Companions' Transition to the Afterlife
books.author: Penelope Smith
books.description: Explores how animals experience dying and death, what they communicate from the afterlife, and how people can stay connected with animal companions who have passed on.

courses.title: Become an Animal Whisperer
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course on telepathic communication with animals, using her long-tested methods and real-time practice to shift into a receptive state of consciousness.

courses.title: Advanced Animal Whispering
courses.description: A twelve-module self-paced video course that deepens telepathic communication with animals and the wider natural world. It includes the seven-module introductory programme.

courses.title: How to Communicate with Animals: The Basic Course
courses.description: A home-study audio course with companion booklet covering the foundational exercises she has taught in her live Basic Course since the 1970s. Available as a CD set or digital download.

courses.title: How to Know if Telepathic Communication with Animals is Real (seminar recording)
courses.description: A 99-minute recorded seminar on how telepathic communication is received and how to tell genuine communication from projection or imagination. One of a library of her historic teleseminar recordings.

free_resources.title: How to Activate Your Innate "Animal Whisperer" Skills
free_resources.description: A free video event on The Shift Network exploring how telepathic animal communication works and how to tell intuitive communication apart from imagination and self-doubt. Registration gives access to the recording.

Spiritpedia's subject list has no animal-communication subject; items use consciousness/spirituality (and death-the-afterlife for Animals in Spirit). A human may want a better fit.
Her YouTube avatar is under 300 px (295), so it was not used; photos are her website portrait and the Shift headshot.
Her own audio and teleseminar products share one page each on her site, so only one item per page was listed (unique-URL rule).
The Basic Course price is the CD-set sale price ($44; regular $55; digital download $55). Become an Animal Whisperer is a Shift sale price ($297; regular $347).
The free Shift event offers the recording on registration; it is promoting a live course, so check it stays available.
